Definition
Source: topping:page-0010 1. ch1:2.2–ch1:2.4\group ricci-solitons A metric $g_0$, vector field $Y$, and constant $\lambda \in \mathbb R$ define a Ricci soliton when \[ -2\Ric (g_0)=\mathcal L_Yg_0-2\lambda g_0. \] It is steady, expanding, or shrinking according as $\lambda =0$, $\lambda <0$, or $\lambda >0$, respectively.
